dialog.heading: Add column
dialog.keyHint: A label or annotation key, e.g. app.kubernetes.io/name.
dialog.pathHint: A dotted path, e.g. .spec.nodeName, .status.phase or .spec.containers[0].image. Keys with dots go in brackets: .metadata.labels["app.kubernetes.io/name"].
dialog.metadataOnlyHint: This table lists metadata only: field paths must start with .metadata.
dialog.secretNote: Secret values are never shown: Sextant reads objects with them already removed.

errors.keyInvalid: Not a valid key. A key is an optional prefix such as example.com/ and a name of up to 63 letters, digits, -, _ and . that starts and ends with a letter or digit.
errors.pathInvalid: Not a simple path. Use names joined by dots, [0] for a list item and ["key"] for a key with dots. Wildcards, filters and functions are not supported.
errors.secretData: The values of a Secret (data and stringData) cannot be shown in a column.
errors.inlineSecret: This field holds secret material of the object, so it cannot be shown in a column.
errors.metadataOnly: This table lists metadata only: use a path that starts with .metadata.
errors.full: This table has the most custom columns it can have: {{max}}. Remove one first.
errors.duplicate: This table already has this column.
errors.tooMany: The list of custom columns is full. Remove columns of other tables first.
